Liquid Death CEO on Viral AI Data Center Ad, IPO Odds
videos.description: Mike Cessario, Founder and CEO of Liquid Death, joined the program to discuss the growing public sentiment against the rapid expansion of data centers. Despite widespread interest in AI investments, the mood around data center growth has been notably negative. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Rep. McCormick Warns Against Slowing AI Buildout

videos.title: AI Takes Center Court at the US Open
videos.description: IBM and the US Open are expanding their use of AI to give fans real-time match insights, including personalized updates, an AI assistant and win probabilities that change after every point. IBM Senior Vice President Jonathan Adashek and former tennis player Sam Querrey are on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini how the technology also gives players and coaches deeper data to analyze opponents and match strategy while helping more than 14 million digital users follow the tournament. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
